gloss: completely; without omission; in full; leaving nothing out

definitions.gloss: completely; without omission; in full; leaving nothing out
definitions.explanation: An adverbial expression meaning to do something thoroughly, covering every aspect without leaving anything remaining or unused.

examples.japanese: ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}すところなく⟦{発揮|はっき}した→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧。
examples.english: He demonstrated his talent to the fullest.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}すところなく⟦{紹介|しょうかい}している→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧。
examples.english: This book introduces Japanese history in its entirety.

examples.japanese: ⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}すところなく⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}す→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧⟦{料理法|りょうりほう}→料理法：26096_ryourihou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}びたい→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I want to learn cooking techniques that bring out the full flavor of the ingredients.

notes:
Literally "leaving no remainder," from ⟦{余|あま}す→余す：27283_amasu⟧ (to leave over) + ⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧ (aspect; part) + ⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without). A somewhat literary adverbial expression that emphasizes thoroughness and completeness. Often used in written or formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}すところなく⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧: to demonstrate one's talent fully
- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}すところなく⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to convey the appeal completely
- {余|あま}すところなく⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧: to introduce in full
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}すところなく⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to put out all one's strength

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{残|のこ}ら→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ず: without exception; all of them — focuses on not leaving any items behind
- ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: sufficiently; fully — less emphatic, more everyday
- ⟦くまなく→くまなく：10332_kumanaku⟧: thoroughly; in every corner — emphasizes searching or covering every area
